dashboard.label: Operational Health
dashboard.description: TA-cveicu add-on operational status and diagnostics

search.query: `cveicu_index` sourcetype="cveicu:audit" earliest=-7d@d latest=now | sort - _time | head 1 | eval last_run=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table last_run
(index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd severity=ERROR ("TA-cveicu" OR "cveicu")) OR (`cveicu_index` sourcetype="cveicu:error") earliest=-24h@h latest=now | stats count as error_count

| inputlookup epss_lookup.csv | stats count as epss_rows | appendcols [| inputlookup kev_lookup.csv | stats count as kev_rows] | appendcols [| inputlookup risk_priority_lookup.csv | stats count as risk_rows] | eval epss_rows=if(epss_rows=0, "Pending", epss_rows), kev_rows=if(kev_rows=0, "Pending", kev_rows), risk_rows=if(risk_rows=0, "Pending", risk_rows) | rename epss_rows as "EPSS Entries", kev_rows as "KEV Entries", risk_rows as "Risk Priority Entries" | table "EPSS Entries" "KEV Entries" "Risk Priority Entries"
`cveicu_index` sourcetype="cveicu:audit" earliest=-7d@d latest=now | sort - _time | head 5 | spath message | table _time message
| inputlookup cve_daily_summary.csv | eval _time=strptime(date_published, "%Y-%m-%d") | where _time > relative_time(now(), "-7d@d") | timechart span=1d sum(cve_count) as events_per_day
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd (severity=ERROR OR severity=WARN) ("TA-cveicu" OR "cveicu") earliest=-24h@h latest=now | table _time severity message | sort - _time | head 20
